rows.note: Use this for the nerve or audacity to do something outrageous, especially in phrases like 有咁嘅膽.

example.english: You really have the gall to yell at the boss.
example.traditional: 你真係有咁嘅膽，竟然夠膽鬧老闆。
example.jyutping: nei5 zan1 hai6 jau5 gam3 ge3 daam2 ging2 jin4 gau3 daam2 naau6 lou5 baan2

rows.note: Use this for resentment or exasperation that someone is carrying around; it is the all-purpose noun rendering for this sense.

example.english: They left me full of gall, and I couldn't sleep all night.
example.traditional: 我畀佢激到一肚氣，成晚都瞓唔着。
example.jyutping: ngo5 bei2 keoi5 gik1 dou3 jat1 tou5 hei3 seng4 maan5 dou1 fan3 m4 zoek3
